sampler_parity.reference: Unchanged engine SHA-256 labelled draws; Python now canonicalizes seed and ids as integers. No RNG replacement.
sampler_parity.sequence: rank by pick<id>, count, ranked gaps; per rank angle jitter, scale, mirror
